<title>Change Log</title>

<a id="3_0"></a>
<h2>Changes for Version 3.0.0 (pending)</h2>

This will be a breaking release. For example, the representation of version
numbers may change. The sx- / sz-based encodings of zettel will change. Zettel
IDs will always be encoded as strings; the numeric encoding will be removed.
The behavior of <code>syntax</code> value &ldquo;none&rdquo; will change.

  *  Change data encoding of zettel list queries. Zettel identifiers are
     encoded as a string value (was: numeric value). Make encoding of zettel
     list simpler by changing <code>(zettel (id ZID) ...</code> to
     <code>(zettel "ZID" ...</code>.
    (breaking: api)
  *  Change data encoding for zettel retrieval: merge encoding/content encoding
     into one list. Now it is: <code>(content "" "Change data encoding
     ...")</code>.
     (breaking: api)
  *  Data encoding of access rights changed from numeric scheme to a symbol
     based scheme: <code>(rights create read update delete)</code>.
     (breaking: api)
  *  Change sz representation of content for headings and inline marks. Node
     identifiers are only generated when needed, e.g. for HTML encoding.
     (breaking: api)
  *  List items are now <code>(ITEM attr ...)</code> instead of <code>(BLOCK
     ...)</code>.
     (breaking: api)
  *  Descriptions get a cleaner internal structure: <code>TERM</code>,
     <code>DETAIL</code>, and <code>ENTRY</code> (instead of nothing (for terms)
     and <code>BLOCK</code> (for detail and entry)).
     (breaking: api)
  *  A table row now starts with the symbol <code>ROW</code>, followed by
     attributes, and then the list of table cells.
     (breaking: api)
  *  Content of zettel with syntax &ldquo;none&rdquo; is treated as empty in
     the API. Previously, it was evaluated to a description list of the
     zettel's metadata. This is now done only in the WebUI.
     (breaking: api)
  *  Remove support for metadata key <code>box-number</code>. Key
     <code>box-name</code> is the replacement.
     (breaking: api, box)
  *  Remove support for writing / encoding zettel with YAML separator
     (<code>---</code>). Read support will be removed in a future major
     version.
     (breaking: api, box)
  *  The result of a block transclusion is only wrapped into an region block,
     if the transclusion element specifies attributes. Same for inline
     transclusion, which are only wrapped into an inline span, if it specifies
     at least one attribute. Unconditional wrapping was introduced in 1.0.0.
     (minor: zettelmarkup)
  *  Add metadata key <code>box-name</code> that will replace
     <code>box-number</code>.
     (minor: api, box)
  *  Allow to retrieve zettel content via data encoding.
     (minor: api)

<a id="2_1"></a>
<h2>Changes for Version 2.1.0 (2026-07-07)</h2>

The main goal of this release is to improve Markdown support. Users will be
able to use Markdown instead of Zettelmarkup. However, Markdown has some
limitations compared to Zettelmarkup, including the lack of transclusions and
fewer text formatting options. In addition, if Markdown documents contain HTML
elements, Zettelstore may ignore or hide them, depending on the configuration,
for security reasons.

  *  Add a second Markdown dialect: emark (Extended CommonMark). It supports
     simple GFM-style tables and strikethrough formatting. Additional language
     elements, such as endnotes and description lists, may be added in the
     future.
     (major: markdown)
  *  Update the Markdown encoder to generate Extended CommonMark output.
     (major: markdown)
  *  Add the runtime config key <code>markdown-dialect</code> to specify which
     dialect should be used for the generic syntax values &ldquo;md&rdquo; and
     &ldquo;markdown&rdquo;. The value &ldquo;cmark&rdquo; selects the default
     CommonMark dialect explicitly.
     (minor: markdown)
  *  Extend file uploads to support additional file types.
     (minor: webui)
  *  Allow the wildcard value &ldquo;*&rdquo; for the
     <code>zettel-file-syntax</code> runtime configuration.
     (minor)
  *  Allow empty table rows by using only &rdquo;|&ldquo; at the beginning of
     a line.
     (minor: zmk)
  *  Trim leading and trailing spaces in table cells.
     (minor: zmk)
  *  Allow <code>zettel-file-syntax</code> to be configured at runtime.
     (bug)

<a id="2_0"></a>
<h2>Changes for Version 2.0.0 (2026-03-06)</h2>
  *  The syntax for signaling a hard line break changes to an empty comment at
     the end of a line. Previously, it was a space character or a backslash
     character at the end of a line. An empty comment may contain whitespace
     characters.
     (breaking: zmk)
  *  Rename metadata keys: <code>superior</code> to <code>superordinate</code>
     and <code>subordinates</code> to <code>subordinate</code>.
     (breaking)
  *  Remove runtime configuration <code>show-subordinate-links</code>
     (breaking: webui)
  *  Use <code>successor</code> / <code>predecessor</code> relation to specify
     load dependencies between sxn zettel. Remove <code>precursor</code> /
     <code>folge</code> dependencies between some predefined zettel.
     (breaking)
  *  Introduce startup configuration <code>refresh-mode</code> to allow users
     to trigger a refresh of the search index or parts of it. Previously,
     <code>expert-mode</code> controlled this, but this overloads its original
     meaning. <code>expert-mode</code> now only controls the visibility of
     zettel. See the manual for details.
     (breaking)
  *  Move key <code>simple-mode</code> from service &ldquo;config&rdquo; to
     service &ldquo;core&rdquo;. Move key <code>sx-max-nesting</code> from
     service &ldquo;web&rdquo; to service &ldquo;config&rdquo;.
     (breaking: console)
  *  Add an action link on the zettel and info pages to generate a Zettelmarkup
     reference to the current zettel and copy it into the system clipboard.
     (minor: webui)
  *  Add support for metadata keys <code>successor</code> and
     <code>predecessor</code>. These can be used to indicate some order between
     zettel where <code>folge</code> / <code>precursor</code> are not suitable.
     (minor)
  *  Many smaller bug fixes and improvements, to the software and to the
     documentation.

<a id="1_0"></a>
<h2>Changes for Version 1.0.2 (2025-12-21)</h2>
  *  Use correct version of Zettelstore Client

<h2>Changes for Version 1.0.1 (2025-12-19)</h2>
  *  Fix wrong default values for startup configuration values
     <code>token-lifetime-api</code> and <code>token-lifetime-html</code>.
  *  Fix many writing errors, mostly in the manual.

<h2>Changes for Version 1.0.0 (2025-12-05)</h2>
  *  SZ encoding of lists (ordered, unordered, and quotations) has been
     simplified by allowing only block elements. Previously, inline elements
     were also permitted to signal a compact list. However, this behavior is
     only relevant for HTML generation. Therefore, the detection of compact
     lists is now performed exclusively during HTML generation.
     (breaking)
  *  SZ encoding of BLOBs has been changed from <code>(BLOB attrs inlines
     syntax data)</code> to <code>(BLOB attrs syntax data inline ...)</code>.
     (breaking)
  *  The result of a block transclusion is now wrapped into an region block,
     which inherits the attributes of the transclusion. A <code>width</code>
     attribute is converted into an appropriate <code>style</code> attribute.
     Similarly, the result of an inline transclusion is now wrapped into an
     inline span element.
     (minor: zettelmarkup)
  *  Some smaller bug fixes and improvements, to the software and to the
     documentation.

<hr>
Older changes can be found [./changes0.wiki|here].
